name: Dean Tweedle
original_name: ディーン＝トゥイードル
source:
Prince Charming & Blunt

This charming professor has an alluring smile that enchants all of the ladies. 
His students admire him but his actions and words can be extremely brusque. Even though his appearance is identical to Dalim, he denies that they are twin brothers.

"Let the professor teach you about real love. Do you think you can handle it?"

[From in-game profile]
